acip: ,DE LA MIG SHES SKYE BA'I RGYU BAG CHAGS NI DE'I RGYU'I RKYEN YIN LA, MIG GI DBANG PO NI MIG SHES KYI BDAG PO'I RKYEN NO,
wylie: de la mig shes skye ba'i rgyu bag chags ni de'i rgyu'i rkyen yin la, mig gi dbang po ni mig shes kyi bdag po'i rkyen no
english: Here the cause behind the consciousness of the eye, the mental seed, is the primary factor behind it. The faculty of the eye is the component of the body that provides a contributing circumstance.
